Citizen 0.7.7 keeps displayed patrols grounded on the rendered planet terrain and updates Pilot docking controls.

- Keep left-click as the flight fire control. Hold F for 1.5 seconds to dock; J no longer docks. Surface-mode F still returns to the ship.
- Set the shared HUD and authoritative docking limit to 14 world units. Docking progress resets on release, target changes, or lost readiness.
- Preserve authoritative patrol state, the citizen plugin ID, saved settings, room protocol 14, and checkpoint format 14.

The release includes main.js, manifest.json, styles.css, citizen-0.7.7.zip, SHA256SUMS.txt, and build-provenance attestations. Install the three plugin files or the ZIP contents into <vault>/.obsidian/plugins/citizen/. Requires desktop Obsidian 1.7.2 or newer.
